{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Soft cotton blouse, relaxed fit, knee-length hem, ivory white (#FFFFF0), breathable woven jersey.
Dark navy denim trousers, straight leg cut, mid-calf length with a slight taper, charcoal grey (#36454F), durable twill denim.
Minimalist leather slip-on loafers, rounded toe, low heel, brown suede (hex code #8B4513), full-grain leather with perforated detail.
Thin gold-plated stud earrings, small hoop shape, metallic gold finish (#FFD700), lightweight metal alloy for all-day comfort.

This outfit works because it perfectly balances the comfort of home-wear with the polished look required for an office environment. The ivory blouse and dark denim create a classic, professional yet relaxed palette suitable for an autumn day without feeling too formal or stiff. Soft fabrics like jersey and suede ensure she remains comfortable throughout her workday while meeting the neat dress code expected at her desk."}
